reuse.why: With no shared link function in this tree, it extracts one assertBankAccountNotLinked helper and uses the existing db query helpers; provider is typed as a plain string rather than the existing sync-source type.

duplication.why: The rule is defined once; each of the five link handlers adds only a short guard call, repeating the provider literal it already uses for account_sync_source.

placement.why: The helper sits in accounts/app.ts beside the link handlers and runs before any write or sync in each.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five calls, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Clear single rule, but a sixth provider must remember to call the guard because the handlers remain separate copies.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by all five *-accounts-link handlers
